name: com.kotecharts/charts
title: Kote Charts — Bitcoin on-chain analytics
description: Bitcoin on-chain analytics API & MCP server, new data every block: MVRV, SOPR, exchange/whale flows

tools.name: list_charts
tools.description: Discover which Bitcoin on-chain metrics exist. Returns every public chart with id, title, one-line blurb, category and formula. Call this FIRST to find a chart id (e.g. "mvrv", "exchange", "whale"), then use describe_chart / get_chart / get_latest with that id. Read-only, no side effects; the human page of each chart is https://kotecharts.com/c/{id}.

query.description: Optional case-insensitive substring matched against id, title, blurb and category, e.g. "sopr" or "Exchange". Omit to list all.

tools.name: get_chart
tools.description: Fetch the historical values of one chart as JSON rows {t, …fields} (units per field: describe_chart → fields). Use for trends, history and comparisons; use get_latest when only the current value matters. Time series are downsampled to maxPoints (default 500, max 2000; first/last points preserved). Use from/to (YYYY-MM-DD or an exact UTC timestamp) to window and granularity (5m|day|3day|week|month|year) where available. Five-minute data is retained for 30 days; daily data is closed-only unless includePartial=true explicitly requests the still-open UTC day. That row is partial:true with partialMethod (trailing24h: rolling 24h ending at asOf, comparable with closed days; asOf: a level as of asOf), estimated (true = blended from yesterday, not exact 5m data) and coverage (share of the UTC day elapsed); never sum it with closed days.

from.description: Inclusive start, YYYY-MM-DD or UTC timestamp (…Z). Omit for full history.

to.description: Inclusive end, YYYY-MM-DD or UTC timestamp (…Z). Omit for "up to now".

granularity.description: Bucket size; must be one of the chart's availableGranularities (describe_chart).

includePartial.description: granularity=day only: append the still-open UTC day as a partial:true row.

exchange.description: Venue scope for exchange-netflow only; default all.

maxPoints.description: Max rows returned after even downsampling (default 500).

tools.name: describe_chart
tools.description: Explain one metric before using its numbers: what it shows, how to read it, caveats, formula, payload fields with units, input data categories, update cadence, known limitations and freshness (last data day, published_at, granularities), plus the page URL, the REST endpoint and a ready citation string. Call it when the user asks what a metric means or before interpreting get_chart output.

tools.name: get_latest
tools.description: Answer "what is X now?": the most recent data point for one chart (plus the previous point for context) with asOf metadata (last data day, published_at, analysed block height). Distributions return the current snapshot; ranked lists return the top 10. exchange selects a venue for exchange-netflow only.

exchange.description: Venue scope for exchange-netflow only; default all.
